item.title: CLARITY Act needs Senate floor vote by Aug 10 as three disputes block the 60-vote cloture threshold required for passage.
SEC targets July 2026 for three crypto rulemaking proposals on token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and trading venue market structure.
OCC proposes $5 million capital floor for payment stablecoin issuers in GENIUS Act implementing rules due by July 18.
Crypto security losses hit $1.1 billion across 212 incidents in H1 2026, the highest total recorded for any six-month period.
Drift Protocol lost approximately $295 million in H1 2026's largest single crypto exploit.
KelpDAO suffered a $292 million loss from a cross-chain vulnerability, the second-largest single exploit of H1 2026.
Morgan Stanley launched low-cost Ethereum and Solana ETFs on July 28, adding institutional equity-market access to both assets.
BlackRock, Coinbase, and Fidelity co-founded the Bitcoin Security Consortium with $15 million pledged for network resilience research.
Stripe, Coinbase, BlackRock, Mastercard, and Visa launched Open Standard, a digital dollar stablecoin network backed by 140 firms.
FATF's Seventh Update found 83% of surveyed jurisdictions enacted Travel Rule laws but only 40% have begun enforcement actions.
Australia's Travel Rule for crypto businesses took effect July 1 under AUSTRAC, requiring identity data on virtual asset transfers.
EU MiCA's July 1 compliance deadline triggered a survival shakeout among European crypto platforms and exchanges.
Securitize registered as an SEC investment adviser, enabling expanded services for institutional investors in real-world asset tokenization.
SEC Commissioner Peirce warned that on-chain protocols generating yield through asset pooling may qualify as securities under federal law.
